title: Move normative TDMA initialization requirements out of AGENTS.md references
description: Correctness review found spec/09-packets-timing.md §14.8 declares the mutable contributor instruction file AGENTS.md and hard-coded source line numbers (AGENTS.md:179/:218, lichen_link_init():147, etc.) normative for protocol initialization/FSM behavior. These references are not stable specification anchors, line numbers already drift, and non-Zephyr implementations cannot conform to C symbol ordering as protocol semantics. State any genuinely normative dependency ordering directly in an appropriate spec section with stable section links; keep platform-specific implementation guidance non-normative. Spec-only fix; no C/Zephyr work is required in this session.
